key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:05C4
name: build_rotation_matrix
description: Reads sine and cosine style entries from a fixed table for three angle inputs and fills a nine-entry fixed-point 3x3 rotation matrix into the output buffer.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:0716
name: return_unchanged_registers
description: Performs no computation and returns the caller's register values unchanged, so it behaves as an empty stub in the math library.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:07B2
name: multiply_matrices_3x3_fixed
description: Multiplies two fixed-point 3x3 matrices by accumulating each row-column dot product, shifting the sum right by 14 bits, and writing nine result entries; all-zero rows are stored as zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:080C
name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Computes the integer square root of a 32-bit value by a binary search over 16-bit candidates, returning zero for a zero input and one for inputs up to three.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:0838
name: refine_square_root_search
description: Narrows a 16-bit candidate root by bisection, testing each midpoint's square against the target until the two bounds are adjacent, and returns the lower bound.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:084C
name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the constant one with no other work, so the caller receives a fixed result without any computation.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:0856
name: interpolate_global_table_value
description: Takes the absolute value of a 16-bit input, bisects a fixed 128-entry sorted table to find its bracketing entries, linearly interpolates between them, and restores the sign.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:088E
name: interpolate_passed_table_value
description: Bisects a sorted 16-bit table passed by pointer to find the entries bracketing an input, interpolates the fraction between them, and restores the sign taken from the stacked argument.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:0892
name: interpolate_between_table_entries
description: Computes the fractional position of an input between two table entries by dividing the scaled difference by the table span, negating the result when the sign flag is set.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:08C4
name: compute_clamped_triple_product
description: Builds two edge vectors from three stacked point coordinates, takes their cross product, dots it with a third vector, scales by values from a structure, and clamps the result to that structure's limit.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0000
name: return_minus_one_status
description: Returns the value minus one and nothing else; it is the program entry stub of the tridee library and reports a failure status to any caller.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:00AA
name: store_two_fields_in_record
description: Writes two register values into fixed offsets 36 and 40 of the record addressed by the first register, returning nothing.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:00C4
name: decrement_use_count_and_release
description: Decrements the 16-bit use counter in the record and, when the counter reaches zero and a pending-release bit is set, calls the routine that releases the record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:00D8
name: release_node_when_unused
description: If the record's use counter is zero, removes the node from its exec list and frees its memory; otherwise it sets a pending-release bit in the record so the release happens later.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:00F2
name: remove_and_free_node
description: Removes a node from its exec list and frees its memory through exec calls, then returns the pointer value stored in the record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:011E
name: open_math_library_with_count
description: Increments a use counter and, when no library base is cached, opens math.library through exec's OpenLibrary call (or a saved entry point) and caches the returned base.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0152
name: close_math_library_when_unused
description: Decrements the use counter and, when it reaches zero with a cached base, clears the base and closes math.library through exec's CloseLibrary call (or a saved entry point).

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0198
name: allocate_guarded_entry_table
description: Returns zero for a null record pointer; otherwise it sizes the table as 84 bytes per entry plus a 164-byte header, allocates it through exec's AllocMem, and initializes the header from the record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:01E0
name: allocate_entry_table_block
description: Allocates a memory block for an entry table through exec's AllocMem using a size passed in, then initializes the header fields from the input record and returns the block, or the original argument if allocation fails.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:023E
name: initialize_entry_table_fields
description: Stores the base pointer and derives the entry count from the record's size value, dividing by 52 bytes per entry, then writes the count and scaled offsets into the structure header.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0286
name: forward_stack_argument_after_call
description: Calls another routine and then returns the value passed on the stack, forwarding that argument unchanged.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0292
name: free_record_and_buffer
description: Clears the buffer pointer at record offset 148 and frees that buffer through exec's FreeMem when it was set, then calls the release path to free the record itself.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:02B8
name: free_two_exec_blocks
description: Frees two memory blocks through exec's FreeMem, choosing between the direct call and an alternate entry point by a flag bit in the caller's state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:02DA
name: free_exec_memory_block
description: Calls exec's FreeMem on the block it is given and then calls a further routine to finish the release.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:02EC
name: allocate_sized_entry_table
description: Allocates a block of 84 bytes for each requested entry through exec's AllocMem, then fills the table header with the entry count and derived sizes, using 52 bytes per entry for the offsets.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:031C
name: allocate_entry_table_from_count
description: Allocates a table block through exec's AllocMem for the given count and writes the header fields that point into it, returning the block or the original argument when allocation fails.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0368
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without modification.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0370
name: reset_record_bounds_fields
description: Copies a stored 32-bit value into the record, clears several fields to zero, and sets four 16-bit bound fields to the signed maximum and minimum values.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:039E
name: project_points_with_depth
description: Walks a list of three-coordinate points, adds the record's translation terms, and projects each point by dividing scaled x and y by a depth-derived term, storing the results in the entries that follow.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:041A
name: compute_dot_product_three_components
description: Computes a dot product of three 16-bit inputs with the record's three weight fields, skipping any input that is zero, and packs the sum into fixed-point form by shifting.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0492
name: project_point_xy_perspective
description: Adjusts the x and y words of a point by dividing each scaled coordinate by a depth term built from the point's z word and record fields, then adding the record offsets.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:04D0
name: copy_object_state_from_record
description: Copies header values and eight words from the input record into the target object, then uses the record's flag bits to return a status code and to copy saved position fields into the object.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:053C
name: save_state_by_flag_bits
description: Returns bit two of the record flags when it is set; otherwise, when the low flag bits are set and bit four is set, it copies five state values into a saved area of the object and returns bit four.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:056A
name: save_state_when_flagged
description: Returns bit four of the record flags, copying five state values into a saved area when the low flag bits and bit four are set, and returns zero otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:059E
name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once with no work and no effect.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:05BA
name: return_without_work
description: Returns straight away without any computation, so it does nothing when called.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:05DE
name: store_packed_argument_words
description: Stores the two halves of the first 32-bit argument and the low half of the second argument into three 16-bit fields of the record at offsets 108 to 112.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:05EE
name: load_object_from_descriptor
description: Copies the flags, transform and bounds fields from an input descriptor into the object, resets two bounds words, runs follow-up routines chosen by flag bits, and writes two saved values back to the descriptor.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0676
name: interpolate_node_list_when_flagged
description: When a flag bit in the object is set, walks a linked list of nodes and, for each node with the matching flags and a valid index, computes a fractional value between two bounds and adds it to the node's byte field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:068E
name: interpolate_node_list_values
description: Walks a linked list of nodes and, for each node with matching flags and a valid index, computes a fractional value between two bounds and adds it to the node's byte field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0724
name: stub_return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing when called.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0726
name: accumulate_node_bounds_flagged
description: When the object's flag bit eight is set, walks a linked list of nodes and, for each node with a non-negative result, widens the object's four bound fields to include that node's extents and records the node pointer in the list slot.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0744
name: accumulate_node_bounds_in_list
description: Walks a linked list of nodes and, for each node with a non-negative result, widens the object's four bound fields to include the node's extents and stores the node pointer in its list slot.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:07E4
name: interpolate_node_byte_by_flags
description: Interpolates a byte value for one node between its index bounds, applying limits chosen by the object's flag bits, and stores the result in the node's byte field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0856
name: scale_node_byte_when_flagged
description: When a flag bit in the object is set, computes a scaled byte from the input value and the node's bounds, adds the node's base byte, clamps negative results to zero, and stores it in the node's byte field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:08AA
name: stub_exit_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no action.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:08EA
name: stub_return_no_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no action, so it has no effect on the caller.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0906
name: store_and_scale_node_byte
description: Stores the input byte in the node when a flag bit is clear, then computes a clamped scaled byte from the input and the node's bounds and writes it into the node's byte field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:093A
name: compute_node_byte_from_input
description: Computes a clamped byte from an input byte minus a scaled term built from the input word and the node's bounds, then stores it in the node's byte field plus the node's base byte.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:096A
name: compute_node_byte_from_word
description: Computes a clamped byte from an input word and the node's bounds, adds the node's base byte, and stores the result in the node's byte field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:096E
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing when called.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0970
name: compute_scaled_node_byte
description: Computes a byte from an input word scaled by a bounds-derived ratio, adds the node's base byte, clamps negative results to zero, and stores the result in the node's byte field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0974
name: compute_node_extent_bounds
description: Finds the minimum and maximum 16-bit field across the node's entry list, shifts both by a scale taken from the node's flags, stores them in the node, and widens the object's bound fields to include them.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:09B6
name: compute_entry_extent_bounds
description: Finds the minimum and maximum 16-bit field across the entry list, applies the node's scale shift, stores the extents in the node, and widens the object's bound fields to include them.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0A10
name: clip_edge_against_bounds
description: Tests the entries of a list against the object's bound limits and, where an entry crosses them, takes a new entry from a pool, copies its coordinates and flags, and links it into the list.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0A6A
name: clip_point_against_bounds
description: Tests a point argument against the entry list's bound limits and, when it lies outside, takes pooled entries, copies the entry coordinates, and links the new entries into the list.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0B72
name: test_point_inside_radius
description: Tests a stored 2D vector against a squared radius; when the threshold test passes it swaps two stored vectors and returns the squared length, otherwise it rotates the vector and returns a fixed-point quotient.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0BE0
name: divide_rotated_fixed_point
description: Rotates a 2D vector by a fixed-point angle pair and computes a fixed-point quotient by long division with bit-count scaling, returning minus one when the divisor is zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0C1E
name: divide_fixed_product_by_difference
description: Computes a long-division fixed-point quotient of two scaled 16-bit values by a difference, returning the quotient with its shift count, or minus one when the difference is zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0C3E
name: shift_and_divide_fixed
description: Shifts a 32-bit value by a count and divides it by a 16-bit divisor using long division, returning the quotient scaled by that shift count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0C68
name: compute_squared_length_ratio
description: Rotates nothing but compares squared component lengths of the object's stored vectors, checks the bound limits, clears a status bit, and returns a fixed-point ratio of the two squared lengths, or minus one when the bound test fails.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0C92
name: return_squared_length_ratio
description: Computes a fixed-point ratio of two squared lengths taken from the stored vector and the input vector, returning the low 16 bits of the quotient.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0CD8
name: compute_scaled_squared_ratio
description: Builds scaled squared components from the stacked arguments and the record, then returns the fixed-point quotient of their products divided by their sum.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0D36
name: compute_fractional_difference
description: Computes the scaled difference of two 16-bit values, divides it by the first value, and returns the low 16 bits of the quotient.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0D58
name: rotate_point_and_clip
description: Rotates a 2D point by a fixed-point angle pair, stores the rotated components in the record, applies the bound test and flag handling, and returns the stored result or minus one.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0DAE
name: return_minus_one_fallback
description: Returns minus one together with the record's stored word, signalling failure to the caller.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0DB6
name: compute_squared_distance_3d
description: Subtracts two stored three-component points component by component and returns the sum of their squared differences, made non-negative.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0DFC
name: store_point_difference_sum
description: Writes the input word and a zero word into the output buffer, computes the difference and sum of two stored coordinate pairs against the record's offset values, and clears a status bit in the record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0E56
name: compute_entry_min_max_bounds
description: Gathers the minimum and maximum x and y words over the stored entries, storing them in the record's bound fields and clearing a status bit, or returning minus one when the bound test fails.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0F1C
name: stub_return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one with the second argument's stored word and performs no other work.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0F2A
name: clip_polygon_against_bounds
description: Clips a polygon's vertex list against the object's bound limits, taking new vertices from a pool where edges cross the limits, copying their coordinates, and linking them into the output list.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:107C
name: clip_vertices_to_threshold

name: clip_and_measure_squared_length

name: return_minus_one_word
description: Returns minus one together with a stored word from the object, reporting failure without other work.

description: Tests a list of entries against the object's bound limits and, where entries cross them, creates pooled entries, copies their coordinates, and links them into the list, returning a stored result word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:12AC
name: clip_segment_to_range
description: Clips a segment's entries against the range given by the argument and the object's bound limits, creating pooled entries where they cross and linking them into the output list, then clears a status bit.

name: clip_list_to_limits
description: Walks a list of entries against two limit values, creates pooled entries for those that cross, copies their coordinates, and links them into the output list.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:13BA
name: project_point_into_record
description: Stores the input word and offset-adjusted coordinates into the record, computes two projected bound pairs by subtracting and adding the reference coordinates, and clears a status bit.

name: compute_entry_bounds_and_test
description: Computes the minimum and maximum words over the stored entries into the record's bound fields, then returns minus one when a cross-product sign test on the end entries holds, otherwise clears a status bit.

description: Clips a polygon's entries against a threshold on the stored coordinates, takes pooled entries where edges cross it, copies their coordinates, and links the new entries into the output polygon.

name: clip_list_against_threshold
description: Walks a list of entries against a threshold, taking pooled entries where edges cross it, copying their coordinates, and linking the new entries into the output list.

description: Clips a vertex list against a threshold, drawing new vertices from a pool wherever the list crosses it, and links the results into the output list.

name: call_through_stub

name: sort_entries_by_key
description: Repeatedly reorders a singly linked list of entries by their 16-bit key word, swapping neighbours whose keys are out of order until the list is sorted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1762
name: test_overlapping_entry_pairs
description: Walks a list of entries, comparing each entry's bounding extents with the next; for overlapping pairs it computes midpoint values and sign-tests them against the object's stored data.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:178E
name: find_overlapping_entry
description: Searches the entry list for the first entry whose bounding extents overlap the given entry, then computes the midpoint values of the matching pair.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1824
name: split_polygons_by_plane
description: Computes a polygon's plane normal and offset from the cross product of its edge vectors, then classifies the vertices of the following polygons by the sign of their distance to that plane.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1862
name: classify_polygons_by_plane
description: Classifies the polygons in a list by the sign of their vertices' distance to a stored plane, using the plane's normal and offset.

name: select_polygons_by_plane_side
description: Walks the polygon list, computes each polygon's centroid, and collects the polygons that lie on the matching side of the stored plane into the output list.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1A34
name: classify_vertices_by_edge_sides
description: Computes the 2D edge vectors of two polygon edges, then loops over the following vertices and classifies each one by the sign of its cross product against those edges, copying coordinates into the work area as it goes.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1AA0
name: set_color00_from_edge_sign
description: Computes 2D cross products of polygon edge vectors and writes the background colour register with one of three fixed values (15, 240 or 3840) depending on the sign combination found.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1AF6
name: insert_polygon_into_sorted_list
description: Inserts a polygon into a linked list at the position given by the caller, relinks its neighbours, and writes the background colour register with one of several fixed values according to the edge signs.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1B60
name: link_entry_into_list
description: Links an entry into a list at the position given by the caller, then loops over the remaining entries, copying each entry's coordinates into the work area.

name: swap_list_links_and_copy
description: Swaps two list links, then copies each following entry's coordinates into the work area, adding 100 to the middle value when the entry has fewer than three vertices.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:1B84

description: Orders two endpoints by their first word, then linearly interpolates the second word at the position where the first word crosses the given value, returning the interpolated word.

description: Contains only a return and performs no action.

description: Writes two register values into fixed offsets 36 and 40 of the record addressed by the first register, returning nothing.

description: Increments the 16-bit use counter at record offset 32 and clears the pending-release flag bit at offset 34.

name: decrement_use_count_and_release
description: Decrements the 16-bit use counter in the record and, when the counter reaches zero and a pending-release bit is set, calls the routine that releases the record.

name: release_node_when_unused
description: If the record's use counter is zero, removes the node from its exec list and frees its memory; otherwise it sets a pending-release bit in the record so the release happens later.

name: remove_and_free_node
description: Removes a node from its exec list and frees its memory through exec calls, then returns the pointer value stored in the record.

name: stub_return_void

name: allocate_block_from_dimensions
description: Computes a memory block size from width, height and option flags, adding a 54-byte header and 40 bytes per row, allocates it through exec's AllocMem, and fills in the header fields.

description: Computes a block size from the arguments and option flags, allocates it through exec's AllocMem or a saved entry point, and fills the header, returning the block or zero.

name: allocate_record_with_dimensions
description: Allocates a record through exec's AllocMem and fills its size and dimension fields from the arguments, allocating a second block when the flag bits request it.

name: allocate_record_and_link_block
description: Allocates a block through exec's AllocMem, links it into the record's pointer fields, and sets dimension and offset fields from the arguments, returning zero when allocation fails.

description: Fills a table of pointers with addresses separated by a stride computed from two size values, writing one entry per row.

name: fill_cumulative_offset_table
description: Writes a running total of a step value into each 16-bit entry of a table, starting from zero, for the count stored in the record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:02A4
name: fill_arithmetic_word_sequence
description: Fills a 16-bit array with an arithmetic sequence that starts at the first value and adds a fixed step for each entry, for the count given in the argument.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:02AE
name: free_optional_buffer_and_record
description: Frees a buffer pointed to by the record at offset 46 when it is set, then frees the record itself through exec's FreeMem.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:02D0
name: free_two_exec_blocks
description: Frees two memory blocks through exec's FreeMem, choosing between the direct call and an alternate entry point by a flag bit in the caller's state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:02FE
name: walk_flagged_entry_list
description: Walks a linked list of entries, skipping entries with a status bit set, processes the entries whose flag masks match, and returns a combined status value.

name: gather_indexed_entry_coordinates
description: Walks a table of indices for an entry, reads the 16-bit coordinates each index points to from an indirection table, and copies them into the work area until a negative index ends the list.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:03CE
name: dispatch_handler_and_walk_list
description: Calls a handler selected from a jump table by an index, adds its result to a running total in the object, then walks a linked list of entries and marks each as processed.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0404
name: process_deferred_entry_list
description: Takes the object's deferred entry list, walks each entry's linked list applying flag-based processing, and returns a stored total together with a stored value.

name: stub_conditional_call_fragment
description: A short fragment of conditional calls decoded from a gap between routines; it has no clear standalone behaviour beyond those calls.

description: Calls a chain of routines chosen by a flag bit in the object and returns one when the chain completes.

description: Calls a routine and, when the preceding comparison leaves the zero condition clear, calls another routine and returns one.

description: Copies the 32-bit coordinate word of each entry in the object's list into the buffer, reading through the indexed entry table or directly according to a flag in the object.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:05BC
name: copy_indexed_coordinate_longs
description: Copies the 32-bit coordinate value at offset 12 from each pointed-to entry into the output array, for the count given in the argument.

name: wait_then_set_pixel_bits
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, then walks coordinate pairs and, for each point inside the object's bounds, sets the matching bit in a 16-bit mask word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:05D6
name: set_pixel_bits_in_bounds
description: Walks coordinate pairs and, for each point inside the object's bounds, sets the matching bit in a 16-bit mask word, without waiting for the blitter.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0630
name: blend_masked_plane_words
description: Writes words row by row into a bitplane buffer, combining each word with a mask from a stored table through an AND and an OR with the stored pattern word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:066A
name: stub_gap_fragment_bad_data
description: Decoded from a gap between routines, so this body is not a reliable routine; it clears a field, makes two calls and then branches on a count.

name: stub_gap_fragment_unreached
description: Decoded from an unreached gap between routines, so the body is not a reliable routine; it stores a word in the object, makes two calls and then selects one of two paths by a size check.

name: step_fixed_point_line_slope
description: Computes a fixed-point slope from two 16-bit endpoints by dividing the scaled difference by a height value, with sign handling, and steps along the edge; decoded from an unreached gap, so it may be incomplete.

name: clip_span_to_bounds
description: Clamps a span's start and end coordinates to the object's bound limits and skips rows that fall outside the bound range; decoded from an unreached gap, so the body may be incomplete.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0844
name: clip_span_pair_to_bounds
description: Adjusts a pair of span coordinates by offsets from the object and clamps them to the object's bound limits, decoded from an unreached gap.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:08AE
name: test_span_against_bounds
description: Tests a span's extent against the object's bound limits and returns zero when the span lies outside them; decoded from an unreached gap.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:08F0
name: step_span_accumulators
description: Advances several accumulator words along a slope by repeatedly adding step values and decrementing a count on each pass; decoded from an unreached gap.

name: walk_span_edges_by_slope
description: Steps two edge accumulators along a slope, checks each step against the object's stored limits, and calls routines to emit span records; decoded from an unreached gap, so it may be incomplete.

name: advance_span_edge_pair
description: Advances a pair of span edges by one step, updating their accumulator words and writing edge coordinates into the object; decoded from an unreached gap.

description: When the object's flag word is nonzero, returns zero for spans lying outside the bound limits, otherwise calls a further routine; decoded from an unreached gap.

description: Contains only a return and performs no action.

description: Returns minus one when the object's flag word and the record's word are both negative, otherwise returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0986
name: clamp_bounds_to_window
description: Clamps four stored bound words of the record to the object's window limits, keeping the tighter value of each pair and storing the results in the object.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:09D0
name: classify_box_overlap
description: Compares the record's bounding box with the object's bound limits, returning minus one when the box lies entirely outside them, and otherwise continuing with edge clipping steps.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0A70
name: clip_span_list_to_range
description: Walks a list of span pairs, clipping each pair's start and end against the stored range and writing the surviving spans into the output.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0AF2
